value_proposition.explanation: Both documents align around mobile business work moving from ideas to meetings and decisions across locations. The prompts preserve compatible ordinary settings—office, home, shared-space café, and adjacent creative work—without mentioning or depicting the target device.

debug.input_assessment: The smart brief and source messaging are aligned on a premium business convertible for mobile leaders, hybrid work, meetings, sketching, collaboration, secure work, and distributed locations. The selected camera is a tight laptop FrontRightCloseUp view with no local props or background details, so most source tasks can only be represented as broad setting context.
debug.count_explanation: Returned exactly 20 distinct prompts. Home, Office, Education, Gaming, Café, and Creative Studio are all represented; source-grounded Office/Home prompts sort first, followed by adjacent Creative/Café and required creative-departure categories.
ignored_fields: BrightEdge search rankings and competitor URLs were not used as scene evidence.
Transport/run metadata and review status were not used as scene evidence.
Product brand, model, device specifications, and hardware appearance were excluded from prompt text by the stage boundary.
Detailed security, processor, Wi-Fi, camera, audio, OS, and AI feature claims were not converted into props or scenes.
debug.diversity_summary: Within a zero-prop tight view, diversity is carried by ordinary support surfaces and settings: corporate desks, home workspace desks, home living-room tables, creative-office work tables, café tables, gaming desks, a classroom table, and a library study table. Visible object diversity is intentionally limited by the camera profile.
limitations: The camera profile allows zero local props and zero background details, so notebooks, papers, coffee cups, plants, shelving, people, and room-depth cues were removed even when present in C-Tech references.
Source activities such as sketching, presenting, video calls, collaboration, and sensitive work are mostly not visible because no people, devices, screens, or task materials can be included.
Café, Creative Studio, Education, and Gaming alternatives are less source-grounded than Office/Home; Education and Gaming are required category departures.
No runtime image analysis or SKU-specific visual inspection was performed.
